name: Azure DevOps Services Integration
description: Integration pack for Microsoft Azure DevOps Services and Server, providing connectivity to Azure Boards work items, Azure Repos Git, Azure Pipelines CI/CD, and Azure Test Plans.

capabilities.name: Project Management
capabilities.description: Integrates Azure Boards work item tracking, epics, features, user stories, and bug states.

capabilities.name: DevOps & CI/CD Engineering
capabilities.description: Integrates Azure YAML Pipelines, build triggers, multi-stage release gates, and deployment environments.

capabilities.name: Quality Engineering & Hardening
capabilities.description: Integrates Azure Test Plans, automated test run results, and bug logging from test failures.

checklists.name: Azure DevOps Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Azure DevOps PAT authentication, Azure Pipeline service connections, and Board web hooks.

items.statement: Azure DevOps Personal Access Token (PAT) includes Code (Read & write) and Work Items (Read & write) scopes.
Azure Service Connections are authorized for ARM deployment targets.
Service Hooks notify external endpoints on build completed and work item updated events.

reviewGates.name: Azure DevOps Integration Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The DevOps Engineer confirms that Azure DevOps PAT tokens and Service Hooks satisfy pipeline requirements.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Azure DevOps integration verify pipeline triggers and Azure Boards work item synchronization?
